topic: compatibility change list for keeping the wide residual through the digital gain
status: PREPARED, NOT APPLIED. The captain has not approved cancelling the residual stop or modifying on-board protection. This list only says what must change together if and when it is approved.
target_path: 25-bit difference -> multiply by the digital gain -> clamp -> output. Because the gain is <= 1.0 in every allowed setting, a residual a few percent over 24-bit comes back inside range after scaling.

compatibility_matrix.detail: residual_pcm widens to signed 25-bit; difference_clip no longer clamps the residual, it only flags
multiply the wide residual; the authoritative overflow count becomes the post-gain clamp (gain_clip_count)
compatibility_matrix.breaks_if: the pre-gain flag keeps driving the guard

compatibility_matrix.detail: memory packs 4x24 bit {reference,microphone,prediction,residual}; a 25-bit residual does not fit, so either widen the word or store the clamped value for display plus a separate wide-overflow flag
compatibility_matrix.breaks_if: existing npz readers are used unchanged

compatibility_matrix.detail: unpacking, residual_saturations meaning, and the guard condition
compatibility_matrix.breaks_if: driver and bitstream versions are mismatched

compatibility_matrix.detail: residual_saturations would stop meaning 'pre-gain overflow that stopped the run'; add a separate field for the pre-gain flag and keep the post-gain clamp as the stopping counter
compatibility_matrix.breaks_if: C compares old and new status files without a version marker

compatibility_matrix.detail: every stored npz stays readable as-is; new runs carry a schema version bump
compatibility_matrix.breaks_if: old captures are re-interpreted under the new semantics

compatibility_matrix.detail: the open question is whether the guard still stops on pre-gain overflow (safe, but trips on loud speech) or only on the post-gain clamp (lets the gain absorb it)
24x16 -> 25x16 widens the product by one bit; re-run the feedback_fir testbench and the timing report before any board run
compatibility_matrix.breaks_if: timing margin is assumed rather than measured

compatibility_matrix.detail: keep v2 bitstream 61bb71aa and the current driver as rollback point two; the reproduced zero-coefficient baseline must stay runnable unmodified
compatibility_matrix.breaks_if: the new bitstream replaces v2 in place

compatibility_rule: bitstream, driver and status schema must be bumped and shipped together; a mixed pair must refuse to run rather than silently reinterpret counters.
what_i_need_before_applying: the captain's decision on the protection semantics question
B's fixed analysis script, so the same captures are re-read under the new definitions
a synthesis timing check on the widened multiply
